issues.description: Wrong page content displayed. Current URL is /design/step-2 but screen shows Step 1 room selection. Expected screen is step-3b which should show style blend confirmation with percentage bars (e.g. 65% Scandinavian, 35% Japandi), a 'This feels right' confirm button, and slider adjustment option.
issues.root_cause: The page at apps/web/app/design/step-3b/page.tsx is either missing or not rendering the style blend confirmation UI. The console logs show page:mount events for step-3b but the screenshot shows room selection UI. Additionally, the hydration error in console shows 'Server: Which room are we designing? Client: Style Quiz' indicating step-3/page.tsx has a hydration mismatch where the page title differs between server and client renders.

issues.description: Hydration error in step-3/page.tsx: server renders 'Which room are we designing?' but client renders 'Style Quiz'. This causes the entire root to switch to client rendering.
issues.root_cause: The component at step-3/page.tsx has a conditional or dynamic title that differs between server and client renders, likely using browser-only APIs (localStorage, window, etc.) to determine the heading text without being wrapped in useEffect or dynamic import.

issues.description: Style blend confirmation page (step-3b) is not showing the correct UI - percentage bars for top styles, human-readable style names, confirm button, and slider adjustment option are all missing.
issues.root_cause: The step-3b page likely reads style data from localStorage or state that isn't available during SSR, causing it to render empty or fallback content. The page needs to be a client component with 'use client' directive and handle the initial render state properly.
